annotations.text:
Design specification
Typography: Source Serif 4 with CJK serif fallbacks. Metadata uses system-ui at 11.5px for readable lists.
Palette: paper #faf7f2; cards #fffdfa; ink #1f1b16; secondary #4a4238; muted #6f6558 / #8a7f70; borders #e3ddd2 / #eee7dc; accent #a4551f; progress #c99a72; highlight #f6e4d3.
Cards use 3px corners, a 3px accent top border and a two-layer shadow. In the 380px popup, use serif for titles and large numbers, and system-ui for metadata. A solid dot and status label mark finished articles and queued vocabulary.

About sample data
The leak entry's pronunciation, translation and contextual explanation came from an actual MiniMax development response. Article titles are real examples, but word counts, durations, sessions and dates are illustrative. Review totals are chosen to resemble normal usage, not a benchmark.

CSS implementation
Paper-and-ink surfaces cover the popup, side panel, settings and translation popover, including a warm dark theme. The narrow popup relies on clear typography roles. Latin Source Serif 4 regular, semibold and italic fonts are bundled. Chinese AI output uses system CJK serif fonts rather than an incomplete subset or a large full font bundle.
